known_issues: Attach replays the whole journal: slow and memory-heavy for very long sessions (needs keyframes).
Two windows on one session would both answer terminal queries.
Journals are never compressed (pruning by age and total size exists).
A new window build talks to whichever daemon build is already running; only the protocol number is checked.
Colour emoji render monochrome; no ligatures; double-line boxes and undercurl are approximations.

Claude Code ran a working session of several hours inside PROTEUS 0.2.0 on 2026-11-16 (128x30), but no recorded session has been replayed through the gate, and its documentation says ConPTY hosts can leave fragments under its fullscreen renderer. vim and other full-screen programs are untested.
A prompt sent ~20 s after launching Claude Code did not appear; later typing did. Probably sent during its startup; not reproduced.
Flood through the daemon is ~25% slower than in-process (per-chunk journal write, copy and socket flush).
Journals are plaintext and include everything printed.
Verified once each, by hand rather than by the gate: window resize, real key events, dense 1088x179 grid.
wgpu is 27.0.1; 30.0.2 is available. Not migrated: three major versions of API change and no measured need yet.
The light field has only been seen in rendered frames, never judged in motion by a person.
PSReadLine ghost-text predictions make typed characters count as in-place changes, so they appear without the typing flash.
No person has listened to the sound yet: levels, pitches and the red/green colouring are untuned guesses checked only by numbers.
Red text is not always an error (a diff's removed lines are red); the rough note follows the colour, not the meaning.
Sound follows a changed default output device (headphones plugged in) only when the window next gains focus after a minute.
The first key or text sound after an unfocused window has been silent for a minute is dropped (the device takes 20-210 ms to open).

Idle samples taken while the machine is in use vary: one sound-off window read 1.0% of a core over 50 s and 0.0% over the next 50 s. Cause not found; mouse movement over a focused window is suspected.

proteus shot --journal ignores the sizes recorded in the journal and replays into a grid sized from the image, so a session recorded at another size renders garbled (found by rendering a live 128x30 session at 121 columns).
Sessions inherit the launching process's token. On 2026-11-16 the shell agents ran in held a High-integrity (administrator) token with SeDebugPrivilege; PROTEUS neither shows nor lowers it.

Marks and status reports are read by the scanner but not yet journaled, delivered to the window, drawn or heard; the PowerShell integration is not loaded by default; OSC 8 links are parsed but never drawn.
Test runs leave folders behind in the temp directory (proteus-*-test-<pid>): the daemon test cannot delete a folder its own console host still has open.
config.json is only written on first run, so an existing file does not list the new keys: sound (true/false) and volume (0 to 1) work when added by hand.
